name: Status Reason Information 8
definition: Set of elements used to provide information on the status reason of the transaction.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Specifies the reason for the status report.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Further details on the status reason.||Usage: Additional information can be used for several purposes such as the reporting of repaired information.

StatusReasonRule.definition: If Reason/Code is equal to NARR, then AddititionalInformation must be present.
